content.text:
I merged #94 and cut **v2.5.5**. The release is still a draft: CONTRIBUTING.md has a person review it before publishing, so I left that step to you.

1. **#94:** squash-merged into `main` as `420a249`. All of its checks passed.
2. **Release PR [#95](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/pull/95)** (`chore: release 2.5.5`): bumps `package.json` and `package-lock.json` to 2.5.5. `npm run check` passed locally and CI passed, then I squash-merged it as `839f8b9`.
3. **Tag:** I pushed the annotated tag `v2.5.5` on `839f8b9`. `release.yml` succeeded: it checked the tag, ran the quality checks, created the draft release and moved `v2` to the same commit.

**Your step:** review and publish the [draft release](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/releases/tag/untagged-a074836406956702d040). Its notes, under **Changed**:
- **pi-action fits the images of every tool to the model** (#93, changed in #94). This includes the new `fit-images` extension and the fact that extensions can no longer use that name.
- **Updated pi to 1.6.0** (#93, changed in #94). The system prompt is the same as in 1.5.2, and the docs examples now use pit v0.39.2.

The workflow added the Full Changelog link (v2.5.4...v2.5.5). The other commits since v2.5.4 are #91 (dev dependencies, the app token action and pit in the repo's own workflow) and #92 (docs only). The notes don't list them because users won't notice either change.
